cardino.evidence: Complete original French Cartino/Cardino rules, D. F. Oudolf, Ravensburger/Otto Maier 1974. Corrected identity 2116 explicitly lists Cardino as alternate title; original wrong 2405 Bezique preserved in identity ledger. Full components, five-tile hands, one-suit placement, touching-neighbor scoring, jokers, five-tile bonus, score chips, exhausted-bag ending and penalties, with all six illustrated examples. Native text read throughout; original PDF diagrams retained. Source designer/publisher differ from summary metadata; no full summary audit.

finis-ton-assiette.evidence: Complete original French Finis ton assiette! rules, Pierre-Nicolas Lapointe/Arnaud Quéré, all four numbered rule-card faces on PDF page 2. Original image visually read in full: three plates/four-card hands, draw/play, matching forks and magic forks, both special actions, unable-to-play replacement, immediate final-plate victory and age-four variant. OCR reading order and line breaks are imperfect; legible original four-panel image is authoritative.

gumball-rally.evidence: Complete French translation credited to LudiGaume of Ted Cheatham/Z-Man Gumball Rally. Full setup including exact hazard-deck construction, three-card hands, positional turn order, number/color overtaking, regular/major hazards and ordering, both checkpoints, finish scoring and photo-finish option. All two main pages read; translation authorization not independently established.

rock-island.evidence: Complete French translation by François Haffner of Zug nach Westen/Rock Island, Michael Blumöhr. Correct Chicago-to-Kansas-City railroad race, 90 land/10 river tiles, crews/locomotives. All setup, initial reveal, crew movement/rotation, tile replacement, locomotive movement and victory read, including explicit Hans im Glück versus Mattel dice/movement differences and experienced-player variant. Summary designer differs from source; no full summary audit. Translation authorization not independently established.

baron.evidence: Complete original French Tilsit 2006 Baron rulebook, Franz Gaudois/Olivier Fagnère. Full eight main pages read, including contents/setup, tile-market costs, placement restrictions and honor bonuses, optional keeps, barony completion, all single/multiple/simultaneous combat cases, shared own tiles, elimination and final incomplete-barony resolution, plus final reference page. Correct 2–5 player castle/hex-tile game. Resolves inactive publisher-link hold; diagrams retained in original PDF.

big-kini.evidence: Complete French LudiGaume translation by Frédéric Frenay of Guido Eckhoff Big Kini: five-page base rules plus four-page experienced-player supplement. All base setup/influence/island functions, six actions, double/paid spaces, elections/goods, discovery, round reset, 12-round or last-atoll ending and scoring/ties read. Additional layouts/5–6-player notes, solitaire, action cards and clarifications retained and explicitly separated in source. Foreword mentions earlier beta history but presents resulting experienced-player variant; not substituted for base rules. Translation authorization unverified.

giganten.evidence: Complete original French Carlit Dinosaures/Giganten large modular-board edition, Herbert Pinthus identity, archive game page BGG 8395. Cover plus eleven numbered rules pages: hidden-rank reptiles/nests, four square-grid board sections, 25 supplied figures including optional ghost, setup, orthogonal movement, optional adjacent challenges, flying scout, terrain-dependent values, same-family draws versus different-family mutual losses, special creatures/lightning, nest/immobilization victory, variants and final reference. All rules read in OCR; original printed pages 5 and 7 visually confirm movement/combat. Table OCR is imperfect, original figure values/diagrams authoritative. Specific summary contradictions recorded separately; no full audit.

all-the-king-s-men.evidence: Complete original French Miro/Parker Brothers 1980 Les Fous du Roi sheet, correct All The Kings Men arrow-directed chess variant. Original full sheet visually read, including initial-position diagram, one king/four knights/seven archers each, directional arrows, one-step king/archer, unlimited straight knight move without jumping, capture and Assaut/three defenses. OCR diagrams are imperfect; original authoritative. Summary incorrectly supplies only four archers each and corresponding setup; specific finding separately recorded. No full audit.

composio.evidence: Complete original French Composio instructions plus scoresheet, correct cumulative-letter word game. Full rule sheet visually read: 2–4/team play, precept cards, one-minute turns, reveal one letter without announcing whole word, repeated letters permitted as illustrated by i/i/q/o example, round elimination, final surviving word revelation/validation, points equal full word length or invalid-final-word penalty per placed stone, twelve rounds, dictionary/word types and variants. Original explicitly says twelve rounds twice; OCR misreads one as eleven. Source scan rather than OCR is authoritative. Summary scoring/letter constraints conflict; findings recorded separately, no full audit.
